author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@mrkrndvs Most of my subdomains or for up MOOCs or pop-up learning events. I have found since so many users are new to Wordpress trying to do feeds for different catalogs, let alone post-kinds or other #indieweb tools to be difficult for them to follow.

Plus I like pretty. Different communities deserve different stylesheets.
